name: magpie-codex-stateless
description: magpie gateway middleware for GPT models over the Responses API: strips previous_response_id, item ids and encrypted reasoning from requests before routing, fixing the Azure-OpenAI resource-bound 400s ('item was created under a different resource', 'Previous response not found', 'encrypted content could not be verified') that Codex hits on multi-resource Azure relays

summary.en: Fix Azure-relay 400s for GPT models on the Responses API: make Codex requests stateless (strip previous_response_id, item ids, encrypted reasoning) before routing.
summary.zh: 修 GPT 模型走 Responses 协议时 Azure 系中转的 400：把 Codex 请求变成无状态形态（剥 previous_response_id、item id、加密思维链）再路由。
